description: Formulas \(\varphi\) and \(\psi\) at the same context size are semantically equivalent over a theory when they have the same truth value in every model under every free-variable assignment and every tuple of values for the in-scope placeholders; the empty theory gives equivalence in all nonempty structures.
signature:
FirstOrder.Language.Theory.Iff.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w} {n : ℕ} (T : L.Theory)
  (φ ψ : L.BoundedFormula α n) : Prop
